method_detail: BEIR edition of CQADupStack native StackExchange 'duplicate of' moderator links (BeIR/cqadupstack-qrels unix/test.tsv). Query = a held-out question; relevant = its native duplicate question(s) present in the corpus (binary grade=1). qrels restricted to the 150 selected held-out queries -> 239 rows (avg 1.59 rel/query). No closure/union-find needed (links are already question->duplicate-question pairs); self excluded.
annotator: upstream (StackExchange moderators 'duplicate of' links, via Hoogeveen et al. CQADupStack + BEIR repackaging)

source.citation: Hoogeveen, Verspoor & Baldwin 2015/2016 (ADCS), 'CQADupStack: A Benchmark Data Set for Community Question-Answering Research'; Sep-2014 StackExchange dump; BEIR repackaging Thakur et al. 2021
source.subforum_rationale: the most ITSM-adjacent IT/tech subforum (nearest to A's IT support tickets); adapter is slice-agnostic — re-fetch another subforum into corpus/raw/C_cqadupstack/ + re-run to re-slice (a thinker decision). See docs/research/C_source_duediligence.md.

query_selection.drawn_from: the 1072 JUDGEABLE queries (a query is judgeable iff it has >=1 native-relevant doc present in the corpus; all 1072 judgeable -> 100% coverage, 0 missing)
query_selection.qrels_shape: TREC `qid 0 docid 1` (same shape as B native)

egress_ref.operation: full ingest fetch BEIR CQADupStack (unix subforum)

files.qrels: corpus/qrels/C_cqadupstack_qrels.trec (239 rows, regenerable:false, committed, sha256=e2b2289b3e3e2712bd2430484e97d337e124b3d9d6c3bb72385415469b3c39c5, HARD hash-verified)

calibration: native duplicate-detection / known-item bench (StackExchange moderator 'duplicate of' links). comparability_class=native -> CROSS-COMPARABLE to B native (same family), NOT to A llm_judge. DISCRIMINANCE (the A lesson): corpus median 613 chars / 101 words (vs A's hollowed 72 chars / 11 words) + normalized-collision 0.01% (4 rows / 2 clusters, vs A's 34%) -> DISCRIMINANT (strongly). Full acquisition report: docs/research/C_acquisition.md.

seal.mechanism: manifest-hash seal: sealed:true + verify_manifest_hashes(m,'C') wired into Makefile eval-verify; qrels-only hard-verify (regenerable JSONL skipped -> cold-clone-correct). baseline_lock.json untouched.
